summary: The lecture surveys modern security models, contrasting traditional ACLs and capabilities with Zero Trust Architecture and related principles such as least privilege and micro‑segmentation. It then explores advanced protection techniques—including centralized logging, differential privacy, zero‑knowledge proofs, blockchain, smart contracts, and machine‑learning‑based behavioral analytics—followed by practical OS hardening measures like ASLR, RELRO, and SELinux.
title: Modern Security Models and Advanced Protection Techniques
